author: Stahly
description:
We're at the start of a new Warhammer 40k edition, and one thing is as certain as death and taxes: a flood of new Space Marine kits. But how much of what's in the new Intercessor Squad, the multipart Vanguard Veterans and Outriders, and the Eradicators and Land Speeder is actually new? We've unboxed every kit for you, with high-res sprue images, a walkthrough of the assembly instructions, and a full breakdown of every build option.

The post More bitz, same ideas: 2026 Intercessor Squad, Outriders, Vanguard Veterans, Eradicators & Land Speeder unboxed appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: More bitz, same ideas: 2026 Intercessor Squad, Outriders, Vanguard Veterans, Eradicators & Land Speeder unboxed
